This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Solo" />

==Biology and appearance==
This sentient species was distinguished by their [[Color|pink]] skin, protruding [[mouth]]s, and small [[eye]]s seemingly always protected by special [[goggles]].<ref name="Solo" />

==Species in the galaxy==
During [[10 BBY]]<ref name="Timeline">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>, a member of this species could be found socializing aboard [[Dryden Vos]]'s [[Nau'ur-class yacht|''Nau'ur''-class yacht]], ''[[First Light]]'', specifically when the young [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] arrived for the first time alongside [[Chewbacca]] and [[Tobias Beckett]].<ref name="Solo" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|4}}</ref> another member of this species was present at the [[Sorgan Common House]] on the [[planet]] [[Sorgan]] when [[Din Djarin]] and [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] first arrived and encountered [[Carasynthia Dune]].<ref name="Mando">[[The Mandalorian 4|''The Mandalorian'' 4]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The species debuted in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', directed by [[Ron Howard]].<ref name="Solo" />
